Pending owner address set by changeOwner and promoted by acceptOwnership.
Percent multiplier applied to msg.value when creating a participant payout.
Index into participants array controlling which payout is processed next.
Address of the POWH contract; blocked by the notPowh modifier.
POWH interface instance used for buy and withdraw external calls.
Dynamic array of Participant structs holding etherAddress and payout.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, participant registration and payout recipient.
Constructor setting multiplier, powh_address and weak_hands instance.
Payable function pushing a Participant for msg.sender then calling payout.
Distributes contract balance half to weak_hands.buy and the rest to participants.
Calls weak_hands.withdraw with a fixed gas stipend.
Empty payable function allowing ETH donations.
Owner-only function transferring arbitrary ERC20 tokens held by the contract.

Promotes ownerCandidate to owner when called by the candidate.
Empty payable fallback function accepting plain ETH transfers.
send() with low-level call.value(payoutToSend).gas(1000000)() fallback on failure.

External call weak_hands.withdraw.gas(1000000)() from withdraw.

Constructor parameter stored into multiplier.
Constructor parameter address stored into powh_address and used to build weak_hands.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender as owner, granting privileged rights to the caller.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before changeOwner body executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == ownerCandidate before ownership transfer.
_newOwner parameter is written into ownerCandidate.
ownerCandidate is promoted into owner, completing ownership handover.
multiplierPercent parameter is stored into the multiplier state variable.
powh constructor parameter is stored into powh_address.
weak_hands POWH instance is created from the powh address parameter.
msg.sender is stored as etherAddress in the new Participant inside deposit.
msg.value * multiplier multiplication in deposit can overflow before division by 100.
deposit pushes a new Participant entry into the participants array.
deposit calls payout after appending the participant, enabling state-dependent external calls.
payout forwards half the balance through weak_hands.buy.value(...).gas(1000000).
External POWH.buy call can re-enter payout while balance accounting is in progress.
payout sends ETH to a participant via send with a low-level call.value fallback.
Low-level call.value to a participant can re-enter payout before payoutOrder/payout state settles.
participants[payoutOrder].payout and etherAddress determine the amount and destination of the transfer.
payoutOrder selects the participant whose payout is sent and is incremented in the loop.
withdraw invokes the external weak_hands.withdraw.gas(1000000) call.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external ERC20 transfer call.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
tokenAddress parameter is used to instantiate the ERC20Interface for the transfer.
tokens parameter is forwarded as the transfer amount.
notPowh modifier compares aContract parameter against powh_address.
multiplier influences participant payout values later consumed by the payout flow feeding weak_hands.buy.
msg.sender is forwarded as the recipient argument of weak_hands.buy.value(investment).
balance local variable is initialized from address(this).balance inside payout.
investment is computed as balance / 2 and balance is decremented by investment.
investment local variable is the value forwarded to weak_hands.buy.
balance is compared against participant payout to determine payoutToSend.
payoutToSend local variable is the ETH amount transferred to the participant.

normalization_plan.reason: multiplierPercent is only stored into multiplier by the BoomerangLiquidity constructor.
powh parameter is only used by the constructor to set powh_address and weak_hands.
tokens parameter flows directly into the ERC20 transfer call.
tokenAddress parameter is used only to instantiate the ERC20 interface for transfer.
_newOwner is only consumed by changeOwner when storing ownerCandidate.
aContract modifier parameter is evaluated against powh_address when guarding transferAnyERC20Token.
balance is a local temporary read and modified inside payout.
investment is a local temporary computed and forwarded inside payout.
payoutToSend is a local temporary that determines the participant transfer amount.
